notes.title: Thank You, TheBrainDit!
notes.content:
A Big Thank You to Our Russian Community

We are thrilled to express our deepest gratitude to TheBrainDit for featuring Pitfall Protocol on his channel!

Check out the amazing videos he made about our game:

[previewyoutube=0JwJCxJ1sQM;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=hwV69fbdID8;full][/previewyoutube]

Your support means the world to us. Thank you for being part of our journey!

- The Pitfall Protocol Team

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch Notes - 31.7.2024
notes.content:
Added: Title screen message to increase the gamma.
 Changed: Tutorial anomalies.
 Improved: Less annoying tutorial sprint dialogue.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 12.7.2024
notes.content:
- Fixed: Iron Maiden and Mannequins no longer follow the chimp indefinitely.
- Improved: Increased collision detection for the traps.
- Enhanced: Traps can now be escaped even without flash charges.
- Adjusted: Extended the flash duration for the chimp before monsters appear.
- Added: Additional dialogs after day 8.
- Improved: Less annoying tutorial dialogues.
